description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git status' command with a file system watcher extension (fsmonitor). It contains functions for setting up repository states, defining test procedures, and executing various test cases to verify fsmonitor behavior within a Git project.

methods.name: clean_repo
methods.description: Resets the repository to a clean state by performing a hard reset and cleaning untracked files.

methods.name: dirty_repo
methods.description: Creates a dirty repository state with modified, untracked, and new files.

methods.name: write_integration_script
methods.description: Sets up a script for integration testing by defining a hook that outputs the current state of tracked files.

methods.name: check_sparse_index_behavior
methods.description: Verifies that the sparse index behavior during 'git status' matches expectations with respect to ensure_full_index calls.
